statement_en: It is important to note that the condition is that for every symmetric interval $I_{\varepsilon}(L)$ centered at some real number $L$, there are only finitely many terms outside the interval, rather than merely infinitely many terms inside it. This difference is illustrated by the sequence $$b_n=\begin{cases}1&\text{n is even}\\ -1&\text{n is odd}\end{cases}.$$ This sequence has no limit. If the center $x\neq 1,-1$, then for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, the interval $I_{\varepsilon}(x)$ contains no terms of $b_n$. If $x=1$, then outside $I_{\varepsilon}(x)$ there are always infinitely many terms with $b_n=-1$; similarly for $x=-1$. Hence no point satisfies the geometric property, so the sequence has no limit.
callout_body:
一定要注意这里强调的是，以某个实数$L$为中心任意半径的对称区间$I_{\varepsilon}(L)$的**外部只有有限多个元素，而不是内部有无穷个序列的元素**。这其中的差别可以从下面的例子当中看出来:

定义为$$b_n=\begin{cases}1&\text{n 是偶数}\\ -1&\text{n 是奇数}\end{cases}$$的序列没有极限。因为如果我们的对称区间$I_{\varepsilon}(x)$的中心$x\neq 1,-1$的话，只要$\varepsilon$足够小，那么其内部就不会包含任何序列$b_n$的元素，这就无法满足上面的几何性质。但是如果$x=1$,那么$I_{\varepsilon}(x)$其外部始终存在无穷多个$b_n=-1$,反过来$x=-1$也是如此.因此不存在一个点满足这样的几何性质，因此该序列没有极限。
